label: R-act1: the esse of whatever is not its own being is received in a principle and limited
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the reception thesis of the act of being. For every x that is not its own being, x's esse is received in some principle, as act in receiving potency (EsseReceivedIn), and x's esse is limited (EsseLimited). It belongs to a shared-warrant cluster of logically distinct members: 7fcfcee8 (a receiver is in receptive potency, conditional on reception), 14325c83 (no principle is in receptive potency to itself, negative), 7338142d (own being is no recipient), 7de89edb (received esse is limited, conditional) and 1304b462 (limited esse is received, conditional). These hold vacuously where nothing is received; of the route premises, 29e71e43 (every CREATURE_1's esse is received) assumes the reception half for creatures, and with 7de89edb the limited half. It does not say that every pure perfection is a perfection of esse (R-act2): the thin profile of the mode-of-being controls satisfies it while R-act2 fails. Its source arguments (q.4 a.1 ad 3, q.3 a.4, De ente c.4) are to be assessed, not taken as a bare primitive. Open.
